scenario: 社区搜索 (UGC 短文本搜索): 用户在社区平台搜索帖子、问答、评论等 UGC 内容。 核心指标是搜索相关性 (nDCG) 和点击率 (CTR)。 关注：语义匹配、query 理解、短文本召回、排序模型、LLM 在搜索中的应用。

papers.title: Realize What Matters: Principled Context Representation for Large-Scale Reasoning
papers.authors: Michael Theologitis, Dean Light, Shuyue Stella Li, Benjamin Newman, Yulia Tsvetkov, Dan Suciu
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2609.27173v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Solving complex tasks in domains such as science, medicine, law, and finance often requires assembling interdependent information scattered across vast, heterogeneous sources far beyond model context limits. Existing approaches tackle this challenge by organizing information into more manageable representations over which models can reason, such as graphs, textual memories, and retrieval collections. These representations dictate what downstream reasoning is possible and, ultimately, whether it succeeds; yet their design and construction remain largely ad hoc. In this work, drawing on the cognitive theory of relevance realization, we propose concrete principles for designing AI systems that construct effective representations of very large contexts. We analyze existing approaches and show how their successes and failures map onto their alignment with these principles, and introduce R3Con, a harness designed to operationalize the principl
papers.summary: R3Con 从相关性形成理论出发，为大规模上下文构建提出设计原则，并实现面向跨文档推理的执行框架。在两个基准上对比九种方法，相对最强基线分别提升 20 和 8.4 个百分点；4B、9B 模型超过所评估的 35B 基线，说明上下文组织具有独立价值。
papers.key_insight: 社区复杂问答可先优化证据表示及组织方式，再决定是否扩大回答模型。建议固定模型和检索预算，比较普通片段拼接与结构化上下文对跨帖推理的影响，同时跟踪引用准确率、nDCG 和端到端成本；论文中的模型规模比较仍需在短文本语料复验。

papers.title: Just-in-Time Memory: Learning to Curate Task-Adaptive Memory for LLM Agents
papers.authors: Yefan Zhou, Yang Li, Zeyu Leo Liu, Semih Yavuz, Shafiq Joty
papers.abstract: Agentic memory systems reuse past experience to improve future performance, yet most existing designs curate memory at write time: once a task is completed, its trajectory is distilled into a fixed artifact, such as a reflection, workflow, skill, or reasoning strategy, that is later retrieved by similarity. This forces the system to decide what is worth remembering before the future query is known, irreversibly discarding information and producing a query-independent summary that must serve many possible downstream tasks. Learning such a write-time curator is also difficult because the value of a storage decision may only become apparent when a relevant query arrives, potentially many tasks later, creating a long-horizon credit-assignment problem. We instead retain raw trajectories and defer curation until read time, when the current task is known. Given the retrieved traces and the new task, a memory curator synthesizes a compact, task-adaptive payload tailored to the immediate need.
papers.summary: JitMem 保留原始任务轨迹，在新任务到来后才按需整理记忆，而不是提前写成固定摘要；整理器可直接利用当前任务成功信号训练。在 ALFWorld、WebShop、τ²-bench 上，相对最强基线的成功率分别提高 16.2、16.3 和 3.9 个百分点，未训练整理器也有竞争力。
papers.key_insight: 社区搜索 Agent 可先检索历史成功轨迹，再围绕当前查询提炼可用步骤，减少提前压缩造成的细节丢失。建议从不训练的读取时整理开始，与固定记忆摘要做等预算比较，测量多轮问题解决率、引用正确性和额外延迟，并明确区分用户事实与操作经验。

papers.title: Verifiable Hidden Dynamics Play: Generating Agentic RL Environments from Solved Mechanisms
papers.authors: Xinjie Shen, Wei Fan, Xudong Guo, Jianhong Tu, Yang Su
papers.abstract: Language-model agents increasingly face long-horizon tasks with evolving state, interdependent decisions, and delayed outcomes. Scaling their training requires diverse agentic environments, dependable outcome signals, and low extension cost. Existing generation pipelines commonly construct an environment before defining its outcome rule or annotating its trajectories, leaving dynamics and evaluation to be aligned post hoc. VHD-Play reverses this dependency by sampling and solving a mathematical model before a corpus-grounded setter renders its decision process as stateful tools. The executable dynamics and trajectory-scoring reference are inherited from the same solved model. The pipeline produces 3,300 diverse agentic environments at a cost of a few cents each. Training Qwen3.6-35B-A3B on three families raises its mean agentic score from 0.204 to 0.815 in a five-family diagnostic. Gains also appear on held-out instances from all three training families and eight unseen mechanism famil
papers.summary: VHD-Play 先采样并求解数学机制，再将机制呈现为有状态工具，使环境动态与评分依据共享来源。系统以每个数美分生成 3,300 个 Agent 环境；Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 在三个机制族训练后，五族诊断的平均得分从 0.204 升至 0.815，并评估未见机制迁移。
papers.key_insight: 对搜索 Agent 的 RL 训练，可借鉴先确定可验证目标和状态转移、再生成交互任务的顺序，减少奖励与工具行为脱节。社区试验可构造具有明确证据覆盖条件的多步检索任务，但机制模拟得分不能替代真实用户满意度，需另外检查查询分布和工具噪声。

papers.title: Meet, Compare, or Abstain: LatWeave for Deterministic Multi-Hop Question Answering on Knowledge Lattices
papers.authors: Yuze Ren, Shaoheng Fan, Tao Wang, Yabo Yan, Han Han
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2609.27225v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: Probabilistic question-answering systems -- whether large language models (LLMs) themselves, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), or trained multi-hop retrievers -- conflate "what is known" and "how to reason" into a single probabilistic computation: hallucination cannot be eradicated, evidence chains cannot be audited, and the system answers even when it does not know. We present LatWeave, which organizes knowledge into a multidimensional knowledge lattice and compiles multi-hop QA into three deterministic operators -- meet (constraint intersection), compare (lattice-order comparison), and abstain (structural abstention); LLMs appear only on the construction side (one-shot extraction) and the query-planning side, while the answer-generation path is zero-LLM, zero-task-training, and auditable end to end -- so that question answering over Web-published knowledge becomes reproducible item by item. Rather than claiming across-the-board S
papers.summary: LatWeave 将多跳问答编译为知识格上的交集、比较和拒答三类确定性算子，仅在构建及查询规划阶段使用 LLM。MetaQA 的 39,093 道题上 any-hit 为 0.9975，2WikiMultihopQA 的 1,258 道留出题 EM 为 0.865；IIRC 拒答准确率为 0.971。
papers.key_insight: 可将社区中的结构化条件筛选交给确定性执行，搜索 Agent 负责把问题转成约束，并保留每一步可重算的证据。优势依赖知识抽取覆盖率与条件可表达性，不能把完整知识库结果外推到开放短帖；建议单独统计证据缺失拒答与错误规划。

papers.title: COMED: The Missing Middle Between Routing and Collaboration in Multi-LLM Inference
papers.authors: Norah Alballa, Wenxuan Zhang, Salma Kharrat, Fares Fourati, Zafar Ayyub Qazi, Mohamed Elhoseiny, Marco Canini
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2609.26913v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: No single Large Language Model (LLM) is uniformly reliable across queries, motivating multi-model inference systems that either route among models or combine their outputs. However, routing stops after selecting an initial model, while dense collaboration invokes peers on every query. We show that collaboration is non-monotonic: peers can recover failures that no model solves alone, but can also corrupt initially correct answers. We introduce COMED (Controlled Model Escalation for Multi-LLM Deliberation), a post-anchor controller for selective cross-model collaboration. COMED uses anchor self-consistency, router margin, and a lightweight peer probe to accept confident answers, verify ambiguous cases, and escalate only when collaboration is likely beneficial. We formalize this trade-off with a rescue-harm decomposition showing that selective collaboration improves when rescued errors outweigh collaboration-induced harms. Across medical, s
papers.summary: COMED 针对多模型协作既能修复错误、也可能破坏正确答案的问题，利用主模型自一致性、路由间隔及轻量同伴探测决定是否升级协作。在 16 个开放权重设置均取得增益，MedQA 最高提升 10.7 个百分点；HLE 上 GPT-5.5 从 23.1% 升至 28.1%。
papers.key_insight: 社区搜索 Agent 可按不确定程度选择接受、核验或升级多模型讨论，避免每个短查询都承担完整协作成本。实践中需同时测量修复了多少错误和引入了多少新错误，并以查询难度分层评估答案质量、token 消耗和尾部延迟，而非只看整体正确率。

papers.title: Dual-Hypergraph Indexing: Bridging Knowledge Islands for Multi-Hop Reasoning in Retrieval-Augmented Generation
papers.authors: Qi Sun, Xingliang Hou, Caibo Li, Yijia Zhang, Qiang Li, Yu Guo
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2609.28108v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: While hypergraph-based Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) effectively captures higher-order multi-entity correlations, existing paradigms treat extracted hyperedges as isolated factual assertions. This structural fragmentation engenders rigid "knowledge islands" that bottleneck multi-hop causal inference, temporal tracking, and narrative synthesis. To systematically address these challenges, we introduce Dual-Hypergraph Indexing (DHI), a hierarchical representation framework that elevates discrete facts into structured analytical insights. DHI couples a foundational entity-relation factual hypergraph ($H_K$) with an elevated deep-insight hypergraph ($H_D$) via a dual-pathway aggregation algorithm. Specifically, DHI employs: (1) importance-driven hub aggregation via 5-metric topological profiling and adaptive thresholding to capture spatial semantic clusters; and (2) temporal chunk-chain progressive aggregation via sliding-window greedy
papers.summary: 双超图索引针对多跳 RAG 中事实彼此孤立的问题，同时建立事实超图与深层洞察超图，通过重要性驱动的枢纽聚合和时间片段链连接证据。作者在五个基准上评估，报告 Mix 逻辑连贯性提升 1.53，复杂医学病理推理得分为 85.78%。
papers.key_insight: 对社区 UGC 搜索，可借鉴事实层与跨帖结论层分离的组织方式，让搜索 Agent 同时沿实体关联和时间顺序寻找证据。优先试验需要追踪事件变化的复杂问答，并保留原帖引用；上述离线推理结果不能直接解释为社区 nDCG 或 CTR 增益。

papers.title: Large Knowledge Model: From Papers to a Scientific Reasoning Landscape
papers.authors: Yuan Huang, Sihan Hu, Hongyu Gu, Chao Ma, Jiaxing Zhang, Zhiyong Zou, Caiyu Fan, Yan Xiao, Mingjun Xu, Chenyu Xie, Mingzhen Ju, Zhehao Ma, Qi Zhang, Baozong Wang, Yu Li, Zhiyuan Yao, Ruoxue Liao, Xinyu Li, Linfeng Zhang, Kun Chen, Weinan E
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2609.27297v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: Accumulated scientific knowledge advances inquiry when prior findings help researchers choose new questions, design investigations, and interpret results. Realizing this value at scale requires access to the reasoning that connects research problems, scientific procedures, conclusions, and evidence. We introduce the Large Knowledge Model (LKM), a scientific knowledge infrastructure that transforms the literature into a shared, computationally accessible reasoning resource. LKM represents papers as source-grounded reasoning graphs, couples structural traversal with semantic retrieval over the same objects, and aligns related questions, claims, and reasoning chains across papers. This representation forms a Scientific Reasoning Landscape with three connected views: a Question Landscape that organizes research problems and open directions, a Workflow Landscape that exposes reusable scientific procedures, and an Evidence Landscape that con
papers.summary: LKM 把论文转成带来源的推理图，将结构遍历与语义检索连接到同一知识对象，并组织问题、工作流和证据三种视图。固定回答模型时，作者报告 ChemBench、PubMedQA 和 SciBench 准确率分别提升 9.30%、4.20% 和 14.69%，增益口径沿用原文。
papers.key_insight: 对社区深度搜索，启示是把帖子中的问题、结论、条件和支持材料关联起来，使 Agent 能检索推理链而不只找语义相近段落。可先在专业问答板块建立带原帖出处的证据图，并比较固定生成模型下的答案正确率、引用覆盖与检索成本。

papers.title: UniDataAgent: An Ontology-Grounded Agent for Enterprise Question-to-Report Automation
papers.authors: Yutai Duan, Yahui Zhao, Zhangti Li, Yu Ma, Zhenfeng Qi, Shaoyang Yuan, Jing Fan, Jie Liu
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2609.27257v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Enterprise data agents must preserve organization specific semantics, not just translate questions into queries. We present ChinaUnicom DataAgent (UniDataAgent), an ontology grounded system for reusable question-to-report analysis that separates semantic acquisition from online execution. Ontology Acquisition and Validation stage (OAV) builds versioned enterprise ontologies from metadata, business knowledge, and supporting materials through expert authored business skills, constrained generation, question verification, and selected expert review. Question-to-Report Execution (QRE) stage retrieves semantic contracts for each question, coordinates skills and data tools, validates results, and produces evidence linked reports. Across 27 enterprise tables and roughly thousands of metric types, ontology construction took a few hours instead of about one week manually. It took just a few minutes to generate the reports, instead of several work
papers.summary: UniDataAgent 将企业本体获取验证与在线问答执行分开，先构建版本化语义约定，再检索约定、协调业务技能和数据工具生成报告。在 27 张企业表及约数千类指标上，本体构建由约一周缩短到数小时，业务问题严格准确率为 95.0%，文档 RAG 为 72.5%。
papers.key_insight: 对社区搜索运营分析，可以把指标定义、时间窗口及统计口径作为可检索的语义约定交给 Agent，减少工具调用正确但业务解释错误的情况。适合先用于 nDCG、CTR 实验分析和问题诊断报告；企业表格结果不能代表开放 UGC 内容检索质量，仍需人工抽检。

papers.title: Parallel cut research time and cost in half with GPT‑6 Astra
papers.abstract: GPT‑6 Astra allowed Parallel’s agents to research and synthesize labor-market data in half the time and at half the cost vs. prior models.
papers.summary: Parallel 的案例介绍网页研究 Agent 如何完成跨站点的信息收集与汇总。测试任务覆盖四个州、六个月及六类劳动力指标，官方报告使用 GPT-6 Astra 后研究耗时减半、代码成本约降 50%，同时保持研究质量；案例未披露公开基准及完整对照细节。
papers.key_insight: 社区深度搜索可借鉴更聚焦的子查询和更少的研究步骤，按任务衡量端到端时间与费用。试验应固定问题集并核对答案及引用，区分模型升级、调用次数减少和任务拆分各自的贡献；该案例属于厂商自报结果，证据强度低于可复现论文。

papers.title: LEGO: Synergizing Expert GraphRAG and Expert Chain-of-Thought for Legal Reasoning
papers.authors: Qingjing Chen, Junkai Zhang, Shaochun Wang, Jiahao Ding, Siyuan Zheng, Yukun Yan, Zhi Zheng, Antonino Rotolo, Yun Liu, Weixing Shen
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2609.27009v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: Large language models are increasingly applied to high-risk domains such as law, yet complex legal reasoning remains limited by two structural challenges. First, existing RAG and GraphRAG methods emphasize lexical or semantic similarity while overlooking normative relations among legal provisions. Second, vanilla Chain-of-Thought prompting may generate plausible rationales without enforcing the normative structure of legal reasoning. To deal with the bottleneck of pipelines in the legal reasoning domain, we propose LEGO, a dual-module framework that synergizes Legal Expert GraphRAG and expert Chain-of-thought for complex legal reasoning. ExpertGraphRAG uses an expert-annotated civil code graph encoding these normative relations with a greedy normative-coverage retrieval algorithm to dynamically extract instance-specific provision subgraphs, while ExpertCoT organizes the retrieved provisions and case facts into structured Provision-Fact
papers.summary: LEGO 把专家标注的法规关系图与结构化推理结合，先用规范覆盖贪心算法抽取相关条文子图，再按条文、事实、结论组织推理。基于 Qwen3-8B，在 LawExamQA_Civil 上取得 40.53% 精确匹配率，作者另报告开放式任务比较及双模块消融。
papers.key_insight: 值得借鉴的是以任务所需关系覆盖来组织检索，并让生成步骤显式消费这些关系。社区规则问答可先对版规及适用条件建立小型图谱，再映射到帖子证据；普通兴趣搜索缺乏稳定规范关系，迁移前应验证图谱标注成本及实际覆盖率。
